questions.stem:
In a substitution language, each word has one distinct code. Code order is arbitrary.
banking access rural = pa ni vo
banking savings secure = ze mi ni
access savings growth = vo mi su
rural secure growth = su ze pa
banking access growth = vo ni su
What is the code for “access”?
questions.explanation: Answer: vo. Compare the intersections of the coded lines. The complete consistent mapping is: banking = ni, access = vo, rural = pa, savings = mi, secure = ze, growth = su.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 17 km east, turns left and walks 16 km, then turns left and walks 5 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 20. Net displacement is 12 km east and 16 km north. By Pythagoras, √(12² + 16²) = 20 km.

questions.stem: B is the mother of C. G is the daughter of C. E is the father of C. How is G related to E?
questions.explanation: Answer: Granddaughter. E is a parent of C, and G is C’s daughter. Hence G is E’s grandchild.

questions.stem: B is the brother of F. F is the mother of D. E is the father of B and F. How is B related to D?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. B is the brother of D’s mother F. Therefore B is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: H is the only daughter of D. D is the father of H. B is the son of H. E is the sister of D. How is D related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. D is the father of H, and H is B’s mother. Thus D is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: In a queue of 56 candidates, a candidate is 8th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 46. New front rank = 8+3 = 11. Back rank = 56 − 11 + 1 = 46.

questions.stem: In a queue of 42 candidates, a candidate is 14th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 25. New front rank = 14+4 = 18. Back rank = 42 − 18 + 1 = 25.

questions.stem: Two articles are sold for ₹3000 each. One earns 25% profit and the other incurs 25% loss. Find the combined cost price (₹, to two decimals).
questions.explanation: Answer: 6400. Recover each cost separately: 3000×100/125 + 3000×100/75. Equal selling prices do not imply equal costs.

questions.stem: Two inlet pipes can fill a tank in 38 and 57 hours. An outlet empties it in 57 hours. All three open together. Find the time (hours) to fill the empty tank.
questions.explanation: Answer: 38. Net rate = 1/38 + 1/57 − 1/57 = 1/38. Take the reciprocal.

questions.stem: A boat covers 112 km in still water in 8 hours. If the stream flows at 5 km/h, how far (km) can it travel upstream in 4 hours?
questions.explanation: Answer: 36. Still-water speed = 14 km/h. Upstream speed = 14 − 5. Distance = speed × 4.

questions.stem: A and B invest in ratio 5:7. A invests for 12 months; B joins later and invests for 5 months. A receives ₹114000 profit. What is the total profit (₹)?
questions.explanation: Answer: 180500. Profit ratio is 60:35. Each ratio unit = ₹1900. Total = 95 × 1900.

questions.stem: A sum of ₹27000 earns ₹16200 simple interest in 3 years. At the same annual rate, what would be the amount (₹) after 2 years with annual compounding?
questions.explanation: Answer: 38880. Rate = interest ×100/(principal ×3) = 20%. Compound amount = 27000 × (1 + 20/100)².

questions.stem: A container holds 180 litres of pure milk. 36 litres are removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated once more, mixing thoroughly each time. How many litres of milk remain? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 115.2. Each replacement retains 4/5 of the milk. Remaining milk = 180 × (4/5)².

questions.stem: The average weight of 21 people is 50 kg. One person joins and the average rises by 1 kg. Find the new person’s weight (kg).
questions.explanation: Answer: 72. New total minus old total = (21+1)×(50+1) − 21×50 = 72.

questions.stem: A is twice as old as B. After 19 years their ages will be in ratio 3:2. What is the present sum of their ages?
questions.explanation: Answer: 57. Let B = x, A = 2x. (2x+19)/(x+19) = 3/2 gives x = 19. Present sum = 3x.

questions.stem: A 160 m train moving at 61.2 km/h overtakes a runner moving in the same direction at 10.8 km/h. Find the time (seconds, to two decimals) to pass the runner.
questions.explanation: Answer: 11.43. Relative speed = (61.2 − 10.8) ×5/18 = 14 m/s. Time = 160/14.

questions.stem: The price of a commodity increases by 25%. A household keeps spending fixed at ₹2300. By what percentage must consumption decrease? (Round to two decimals.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 20. New quantity / old quantity = 100/125. Reduction percentage = 25/125 ×100.
